sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 250. Success value 100. 5x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all allies. Activates Vital Strike (10% chance to increase Damage by 50%) for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies iron wall for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time.
-Target: all enemies. Boosts HP recovery effects by 30% for 60 seconds. [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Barracks for 60 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases all stats by 100%; [Special] increases critical hit chance by 100%; [Special] increases physical/magic attack Ability success value by 40; [Special] reduces cooldown time by 50%. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000
[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Status ailment resistance value boosted by 60 for 60 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 250-Ability-Power attack that deals physical star damage to all enemies 5 times with a success value of 100 by 200.
Only [Mission For Two] Lycoris Chisato & Takina can be used as Unlocking Potential material
